tasks.label: Dashboard server
tasks.detail: Streamlit with the debugger listening on 5678. Runs on the host when VS Code is a Flatpak, where pyarrow crashes inside the sandbox.
args: if [ -n "$FLATPAK_ID" ]; then exec flatpak-spawn --host --watch-bus --directory="$PWD" "$@"; else exec "$@"; fi

background.endsPattern: You can now view your Streamlit app

tasks.label: Check
tasks.command: ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy && pytest && cd sync && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
